notes: kb/Work R43 (owner, 2026-09-24): an unsupported facility is unsupported entirely — the owner answered kb/Work PB579 Q1 for the whole class: a rule wholly inside a declined processor-dependent element closes as DOCUMENTED-NON-SUPPORT once the compiler correctly refuses it. Held by derived-verdicts.float-formats-not-provided. || kb/Work PB579 — Nothing in this rule can execute. a) and b) give BINARY-ENCODING and DECIMAL-ENCODING their meaning "in a data item described with any standard decimal floating-point usage", and c) defers the unstated case to §11.9.9 - all three are conditioned on the standard DECIMAL floating-point usages, which are NOT PROVIDED (FLOAT-DECIMAL-16/-34, rows GR17/GR18, rejected COBOL1564 under Annex A.3 item 19). What EXISTS is the syntax and the applicability screen, deliberately and no further: CobolData.g4's `floatFormatPhrase*` parses the bracketed choice-indicator group in either order (§5.2.6.4), DataBinder.BindEntry rejects an encoding-phrase on anything but FLOAT-DECIMAL-16/-34 with COBOL1717 citing GR20a (probe p20: `USAGE FLOAT-BINARY-32 BINARY-ENCODING`) and rejects a repeat with COBOL1718 - and the surviving value is then NOT carried onto PicInfo, which the binder's own comment records as a measured choice ("a field nothing reads is a lookup nothing has ever contradicted"). So there is no encoding to implement until the usages land. Annex A.3 item 20 makes the encoding-phrase itself processor-dependent and §4.2.6 licenses the absence; docs/CONFORMANCE.md §2 row 20-21 records it as N/A because item 19 is not claimed. ⛔ Converting this row to DOCUMENTED-NON-SUPPORT is an owner decision (D13), not an agent's - and it should be taken together with GR17/GR18, since it is derivative of them. || code sites, verbatim from the adjudication: src/WiseOwl.Cobol.Compiler/Binding/DataBinder.cs#DataBinder.BindEntry; src/WiseOwl.Cobol.Frontend/Grammar/Core/CobolData.g4#encodingPhrase
